task_completion.description: OpenBCI GUI is set to 'PLAYBACK' mode in the control panel.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'PLAYBACK' button is highlighted or selected in the initial configuration window.

task_completion.description: The specific recording file 'OpenBCI-EEG-S001-EyesOpen.txt' is selected for playback.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The file path or filename 'OpenBCI-EEG-S001-EyesOpen.txt' is visible in the file selection box of the Playback configuration.

task_completion.description: The Networking widget is opened within the GUI.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A widget titled 'Networking' is visible in one of the application panes.

task_completion.description: The Networking widget is configured to use the UDP protocol.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The protocol dropdown or selection in the Networking widget shows 'UDP'.

task_completion.description: The UDP port is set to 12345.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The number '12345' is typed into the Port input field within the Networking widget.

task_completion.description: The data playback session has been started.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Start Playback' or 'Start Session' button has been clicked, and EEG waveforms begin to scroll across the screen.

task_completion.description: The network stream is actively transmitting data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Start' or 'Stream' button within the Networking widget is toggled to an active state (e.g., turns green or says 'Stop').

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenBCI GUI to configure settings rather than executing background scripts to bypass the interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with GUI elements like the Port text box and Protocol dropdown.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the terminal to manually send UDP packets or mock the data stream.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal is not used to run netcat (nc) or custom python scripts to simulate the stream.

integrity.description: The agent loaded the actual file from the specified path rather than a dummy file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file browser or text field shows the path ~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Recordings/OpenBCI-EEG-S001-EyesOpen.txt.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires the file 'OpenBCI-EEG-S001-EyesOpen.txt' to be loaded in Playback mode. The Networking widget must be set to Protocol: UDP and Port: 12345. Both the main system 'Start Session' button and the Networking widget's 'Start' button must be activated for the task to be complete.
